comment: The narration, one line per scene, in the order they play. stage.js draws each scene; voice.mjs speaks each line in the house voice (Gripply Voiceover Female, the same voice as the app's tours) and saves the words' timings, so the animation lands on the words. A line's 'gap' is the quiet after it, before the next scene's first word.

lines.say: Hands full, and the phone's ringing... again?
Miss the call, and Gripply texts them back for you. Job saved!
Calls, texts, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger... all in one thread.
Whatever you agree becomes a to-do.
Settle on a time, and it's in the diary.
Then quote it, bill it, and get paid, all from your phone.
lines.speak: Then kwote it, bill it, and get paid, all from your phone.

lines.say: And every morning, a brief of who to ring back and what to chase.

music.comment: audio/music.mp3 (Eleven Music, made through Runway). 'groove' and 'finale' are where, in the file, the full groove and the final hit land; the mix stretches the track (pitch kept) so they fall on the first scene change and the end card, whatever the narration's length.
